description_en: Queries the list of sound code label batches for a specified schedule
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定排程的声码标签批次列表
kebab_example: aliyun iot query-sound-code-label-batch-list --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --schedule-code Md3ZiTL888K9llXDy789000000000000 --page-size 20 --page-id 1 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QuerySoundCodeLabelBatchList

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an **ID** value is displayed, you must specify this **ID** value. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no **Overview** page or **ID** value is displayed, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该**ID**值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无**实例概览**页面或**ID**值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the schedule
parameters.name: schedule_code

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 指定每页返回的时间段条数，取值范围：1~50，默认值为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return. Valid values: 1 to 10000. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定显示返回结果中的第几页。取值范围1~10,000，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_id
